text:
incident-bot: Pager: RUNTIME_HIGH_LATENCY on inference-hosted-us-east (INC-6291). Auto-escalating to oncall.

maria: seeing p95 jump to ~1.8s across gen endpoints, some 503s reported by a few customers. Investigating.

kevin: logs show a burst of prefix-cache misses and many small batches queuing -> CPU exhaustion on the worker pool. Also a quantized model rollout started ~10m before the spike.

ashok: confirmed. prefix-store (KV) eviction rate spiked, hit backend hot keys. Batching backpressure visible in queue metrics.

maria: mitigation step 1: throttled batch assembly to 32 tokens and reduced batch wait to 10ms. Deploying now.

ops-bot: deploy started by maria @ 4918273680

liz_sre: oncall handoff in 10m. Maria, can you capture customer impact summary for the post-incident notes? rough counts ok.

maria: rough: ~6 customers saw increased tail latency, 2 customers retried (got 503), error budget usage ~0.9% for the hour window. Will add links to traces.

kevin: short-term rollback suggestion: roll back quant rollout for rwinf-rewrite-v2-quantized to previous non-quant variant. command:
```
redwood rollout cancel --model rwinf-rewrite-v2-quantized --to rwinf-rewrite-v2
```

ashok: also recommend pinning prefix-cache TTL to 30s and enable passive warming for hot prefixes. I'll open a config change.

maria: post-deploy: p95 dropped to 320ms, 503s stopped. heartbeat looks stable. keeping watch for 30m.

ana_pm: flagging customer comms: I'll coordinate with support for the 2 affected customers. Ticket INC-6291 -> PM-221 follow-up for postmortem.

liz_sre: nice mitigation. Let's schedule postmortem sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. Owner: kevin (triage lead), scribe: maria, attendees: eng-runtime, infra, pm.

kevin: action items assigned:
- A1: kevin -> revert quant rollout + add canary gating (due 2026-03-19) [JIRA: RED-1992]
- A2: ashok -> prefix-cache TTL + passive warming change, and add circuit-breaker on prefix miss burst (due 2026-03-18) [JIRA: RED-1993]
- A3: liz_sre -> add detailed customer impact section and timeline to postmortem (due 2026-03-18)
- A4: maria -> collect trace links, sample requests, and metric dashboards for postmortem (due 2026-03-18)
- A5: ana_pm -> coordinate customer comms + postmortem distribution (due 2026-03-20)

maria: creating postmortem doc draft: https://confluence.redwood/infr/INC-6291-postmortem (will populate before sync)

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rota updated. Next oncall: liz_sre -> kevin. :bell:

liz_sre: added remediation checklist to RED-1993, assigned watchers. Please add any missing test cases (e2e with cold prefix warmup).

ashok: will run a small load test with synthetic hot prefixes and quant rollback to validate.

kevin: once rollback verified, we'll add rollout gating: require 10k requests/5m with <0.5% prefix-miss rate before quant can increment percent.

maria: thanks all. If anything regresses ping @channel and I'll re-open the pager. :thumbsup:

ana_pm: acknowledged. See you tomorrow for the postmortem sync. :eyes:
